structure.description: This is a single solid body with no subcomponents. It mounts to vertical posts via M3 bolts through the four corner holes.

assembly_process.instructions: 1. Position bracket at desired height on vertical post. 2. Insert M3 bolts through the four mounting holes. 3. Tighten bolts firmly but do not over-tighten (PLA can strip). 4. Slide shelf onto the bracket support surfaces. 5. For left/right combinations, flip bracket 180° to match post orientation.

fasteners.description: Four M3 x 20mm stainless steel bolts with washers and nylon lock nuts. Washers help distribute load and prevent bolt head crushing into PLA.
